summary: Scoped staleness and operation-volume recovery directives so generated-artifact freshness and operation-volume gaps are suppressed for mid-stream work commands, while closeout/health commands retain enforcement. Added compiler, runtime, and CLI coverage for agent start and inline refresh behavior.
command: COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm check && COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/agent-directive-compiler.test.ts tests/runtime/agent-directive-runtime-integration.test.ts && COREPACK_HOME=/private/tmp/corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts --testNamePattern 'refreshes generated artifacts inline' && git diff --check
